source: The last snapshot before wave 3 of issue #1026 added 0079: the newest commit whose backend/schema/snapshot.json ends at 0078_automation_token_holders.sql. No release commit carries backend/schema/ (v0.5.0 predates it), so the fixture is pinned from a named commit. Each file is `git show <commit>:backend/schema/<file>`, byte for byte, never edited. How the fixture advances: docs/technical/smoke-production-spec.md §8.4.
